layer_3_action.action: A composed, non-aggressive Therizinosaurus with clean high-poly clay geometry is standing calmly in a stable bipedal posture on a light gray sandbar bank. The camera captures a clean three-quarter profile from a straight eye-level view, framing its massive forelimbs raised naturally and symmetrically in front of its chest, showcasing its giant blunt clay scythe claws completely free of any active martial arts poses, human combat stances, or menacing gestures. It looks forward with quiet curiosity among a sparse cluster of stylized early hardwoods and tough ferns under soft, cinematic studio ambient occlusion lighting. No text.
